observation_motivating_test: The prefixed broad-span prediction failed because observed total and mean route-new spans lay below both null 95% intervals, despite the separately prefixed extra-stop incidence excess.
question: Is the rainfall-associated multi-stop expression of route-new species unusually geographically compact?

criteria.spread_excess: Use the already frozen route-new extra-stop incidence result: observed beta above upper 95% bounds under both kappa=2 uniform and a=.75 persistence nulls.
criteria.compactness: In the complete-coordinate physically stable pair set, both total_route_new_span_km and mean_route_new_span_km observed betas must be below the lower 95% null bound under both null families.
criteria.p_values: Report plus-one lower-tail Monte Carlo p for each span statistic; no threshold was selected after seeing the exact p values.

classification: compact_multi_stop_activation if spread_excess and compactness both hold.
interpretation: Support indicates recruited species occupy more stops than expected but within more spatially compact clusters than expected. It does not identify wetland connectivity, individuals, or the causal environmental cue.
